POGO MAMIE - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-pogomamie.txt.

Mamie's cat has run off across the rooftops of Paris, and Mamie is after it on
her pogo stick. She bounces by herself on every landing: steer her in the air,
hold A as she lands for a big bounce over the wide gaps, and mind the pigeons,
the TV antennas and the gusts. From Montmartre to the Seine, the boulevards and
the Eiffel Tower, then all night long: how far can she go? Whisker medals at
250, 500 and 1000 m, the cat caught at 2000 m; your best is kept.

Run PogoMamie.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  steer in the air          Left / Right               Left / Right
  big bounce (hold on       A (B, X, Y too)            X (Z, A and S too)
  a landing); start, retry  A or Start                 X or Enter
  pause / resume            Start (or Select)          Enter (or Backspace, Esc)
  Papi joins the race       pad 2: A on the title or "get ready" screen

Two players race on the same rooftops, Mamie and Papi, each with their own pad;
the camera follows the leader, and a player left behind drops out. The panel
at the end names the winner.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: PogoMamie.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best distance and score are saved in pogomamie.srm next to the exe.
